verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs say it lets users aggregate billing across all providers in one place and track usage through its analytics. Workspace budgets add per-workspace spend caps, and the community reports per-key limits and consolidated billing. However, nothing in the evidence documents spend breakdowns by model, key, team, or user. Missing for 10: documented per-model and per-key spend reporting, per-user attribution, team-level spend dashboards or usage-export APIs, and independent hands-on confirmation of the analytics.
